title: Nicole Peña:
title_short: Nicole Peña (CDO) · Welcome to the Family
headline: CASS's development chief started seeing people when she searched under overpasses for a relative. Every gift puts a case manager in the field.
story: Nicole had a relative who was homeless. Searching for him under overpasses and behind buildings, she suddenly started seeing people.
Every time a case manager gets someone into housing, or shelter staff bring a clean pair of sheets, that's what donors' gifts pay for.
830 people sleep under CASS's roof every night. To new supporters: welcome to the family. Roll up your sleeves.
